title: Fortbildung zum Vocal Coach
text:
At Center Parcs Bispinger Heide, I performed a variety of musical acts, engaging with guests and enhancing their experience through entertainment.

  • Performed live music sets for guests in various locations throughout the resort.
  • Collaborated with other entertainers to create a cohesive entertainment experience.
  • Engaged with guests to promote a fun and welcoming atmosphere.
